title: ConfigureArchivingRequest
description: Request object for the ConfigureArchiving method.

storageLocation.description: The destination for the logs, e.g. S3 bucket name

credentialName.description: The credential name or CRN to use

enabled.description: Flag to enable/disable the archiving process

storageRegion.description: The region to work with when accessing the logs, e.g. S3 region

verifyOnly.description: Whether to only verify the configuration, and not update it.
